points: Dan Hamilton is a fictional character in the BBC medical drama Holby City.
Adam Astill plays Dan Hamilton.
Dan first appears in the thirteenth-series episode “Blue Valentine.”
Dan's first episode aired on 15 February 2011.
Dan is a consultant orthopaedic surgeon.
Dan works in Keller, Holby General's general surgery ward.
Dan was created in 2010.
Dan is characterised as boyish.
Dan is characterised as impulsive.
Dan cultivates an image as a ladies' man.
As a new consultant, Dan plays up to the stereotype of the sporty, privately educated orthopaedic surgeon.
A major storyline follows Dan's relationship with ward sister Chrissie Williams.
Tina Hobley plays Chrissie Williams.
A major storyline follows Dan's rivalry with registrar Antoine Malick.
Jimmy Akingbola plays Antoine Malick.
Dan impulsively kisses Malick during a fight between them.
Critics had mixed reactions to Dan and Malick's storyline.
Some critics felt that the storyline repeated gay plots from other serial dramas.
In May 2012, Astill announced that he had decided to leave Holby City.
Dan is introduced a few days after starting his new consultant job.
